Swaps & offers — phone

The list is the page. Offers are a swipeable strip of photo cards (soonest first); agreed swaps are chat rows below. Tap anything and it opens full screen, over the tab bar, with a back arrow. Same data as the desktop page: 6 offers, 14 agreed.

Every frame is the real page — swipe the strip, tap rows, go back, type in a chat. Tablet (768–1023) works the same way.

1 · The list

Top bar, title, the offer strip, then chat rows grouped by what they wait on. Tab bar below.

2 · An offer

Their find big (what you are deciding on); yours as one row under it. Decline · Accept pinned to the bottom.

2b · A Super offer

The Super line on top; otherwise the same.

3 · A chat — your turn to confirm

Two-line swap strip: back · pair · name · ticks · ⋮, then the confirm button full width. Messages, then the composer.

3b · Tap the pair — the photos open

Both finds big above the chat; tap again to fold.

3c · Confirm — a bottom sheet

The same dialog as desktop, as a sheet from the bottom.

3d · You confirmed — waiting

No button, one line: waiting for them.

3e · No news for 12 days

The nudge sits in the thread.
